title: Unregistered vehicle permit
summary: This page provides information and links for managing an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) for vehicles that are not yet registered.

internal_links.text: Apply for an unregistered vehicle permit
Get an authorised unregistered vehicle inspection (blue slip)

faqs.q: How do I apply for an unregistered vehicle permit?
faqs.a: You can apply for an unregistered vehicle permit using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: What if I need to replace my UVP?
faqs.a: You can replace an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) through the online transaction service.

faqs.q: How do I cancel my UVP?
faqs.a: You can cancel an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) using the online transaction service.

faqs.q: Where can I get an authorised inspection (blue slip)?
faqs.a: You can get an authorised unregistered vehicle inspection (blue slip) through the dedicated transaction page.
